Every item in this collection is characterized by metal construction for long-lasting use, and nearly all are presented in their original display boxes. With timeless designs and renowned craftsmanship, these pens and pencils offer both aesthetic appeal and practical reliability for daily writing or display. Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Suitable for crafts, décor, educational purposes, or coastal-themed displays.

description:
Unbranded
Silver-Tone Metal Smoking Pipe
Traditional Asian Style, Vintage
This ornate smoking pipe features intricate silver-tone wirework and filigree decoration throughout the bowl and stem. The design incorporates traditional Asian motifs, including butterfly-like forms and floral appliques, characteristic of Miao or Hmong metalwork traditions. The elongated, curved stem is segmented by decorative bands and applied filigree, leading to a small, structured bowl area with scrolled wire details and a hanging decorative element.
Silver-tone metal construction with hand-applied filigree and wirework decoration
Traditional Asian design featuring butterfly and floral motifs characteristic of regional metalwork
Elongated curved stem with segmented decorative bands and ring-turned finials
Dimensions: 8.5" H x 3" W x 1" L
Condition:
Good vintage condition with significant natural patina and surface oxidation throughout, giving the metal a yellowish-green hue. No structural breaks or missing filigree elements are apparent. The mouthpiece and bowl opening show expected darkening from age and handling. The metal surfaces remain intact with no evidence of repair or structural damage.

description:
Natural Mineral Specimen
Selenite Gypsum Crystal Slab on Matrix Rock
Rough Geological Specimen, Approximately 6.5 x 5 x 1.5 Inches
This natural geological specimen consists of a substantial plate of translucent crystalline selenite (gypsum) anchored to a sandy sedimentary rock matrix. Selenite crystal plates of this type form through evaporation in saline basins and exhibit distinct basal cleavage, glassy to pearly surface luster, and natural surface texturing. Specimens retaining their natural host rock provide valuable educational and aesthetic display value for mineral collectors.
Translucent crystalline gypsum (selenite) formation showing natural cleavage planes and surface pitting
Adhering host matrix of tan and greenish sedimentary sandstone on the underside and outer edges
Natural raw formation with fibrous crystal growth visible along perimeter margins
Measures approximately 6.5 inches long by 5 inches wide by 1.5 inches thick and weighs 2 lbs
Condition:
Natural geological specimen in rough, as-found condition. The crystalline face shows natural etchings, surface cleavage steps, and minor peripheral chipping typical of raw selenite. The sandy matrix base exhibits natural roughness, light particulate shedding, and mineral staining.

Natural Limestone Slab, 5.25 x 3.5 Inches
This authentic fossil fish specimen is preserved within a cut sedimentary rock matrix slab. The fossil displays articulate anatomical preservation, highlighting the vertebral column, rib structures, fins, and caudal tail. Natural vertebrate fossils from sedimentary lakebed deposits are prized display pieces among natural history collectors and paleontology enthusiasts.
Genuine articulated bony fish fossil specimen in natural stone matrix
Observable anatomical details include spinal vertebrae, rib rays, and fin structures
Cut rectangular slab displaying natural sedimentary layering along edges

Stone slab is solid and stable, displaying natural edge wear, minor chipping, and layered sediment lines typical of quarried specimens. Reverse shows natural texture with faint marking. No repairs or structural fractures.

title: 11.5lb Crystal & Mineral Specimen Lot–Raw Clusters,Geodes,Carvings,Tumbled Stone
description:
Description:
Large 11.5 lb Crystal & Mineral Specimen Lot - Raw Clusters, Geodes, Carvings, Glass Jars & Tumbled Stones
Large Raw Clusters:
Multiple heavy, crystalline quartz and calcite matrix clusters showcasing beautiful natural formations.
Rose Quartz Pyramid:
A carved and polished geometric display piece.
Curated Display Jars:
Two glass jars packed with specimens, including one labeled "Kentucky Trip" containing raw regional minerals.
Premium Tumbled Stones:
A vibrant assortment of polished favorites like Amethyst, Carnelian, Green Aventurine, Rose Quartz, and Agate.
Net Weight:
11.5 lbs of stones/jars (verified on a digital scale).
See photos for conditions and details. Items are sold As Is.
Condition: Sold as is.
Raw Specimen Condition:
The rough stones and clusters are in their natural, unpolished state. Expect typical minor shedding, natural fractures, and earthy matrix residue as found in nature.
Polished/Carved Condition:
The Rose Quartz pyramid and tumbled stones feature high-shine finishes. One or two tumbles show minor surface pits typical of natural pocket stones.
Display Jars:
Glass jars are completely intact with working metal clasps and lids; the copper-toned lid shows light, cosmetic vintage wear.
Additional wear and cosmetic issues may be present.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
Please Note:
